caption: The drawing depicts a tan-colored carousel horse, oriented to the right, with its legs raised as if in mid-gallop. The mane and tail are highlighted with orange-brown accents and detailed linework. The horse is outfitted with a decorative saddle that features ornate designs in red, green, and gold, and is bordered by brown leather straps. On the rear of the saddle, there is a sculpted lion’s head, while the side panel near the horse’s front shoulder displays a large feathered wing with a human face at its base, both rendered in shades of brown and gold. The hooves are painted dark gray, and the horse wears a bridle in matching tones. The background is plain, off-white, without any additional objects or scenery.
title: Carousel Horse
